name: adar-design
description: Apply the Adar Design retro design system when building, theming, or restyling websites and UI. Selectable visual modes — retro: BIOS/POST/text-mode, 80s Arcade, Terminal/CRT, Vaporwave, Windows 95, Commodore 64, Game Boy, Cyberpunk, Stranger Things, Atari/Sierra, The Incredible Machine, 80s NASA; fine art: Kandinsky, Goya, Bauhaus, Cubism, Expressionism, Fauvism, Folk-art, Impressionism — plus composable mixes that override whole token groups. Use when the user asks for a retro, underground, 80s, arcade, neon, terminal, hacker, CRT, BIOS, DOS, VGA, text-mode, vaporwave, synthwave, win95, C64, gameboy, cyberpunk, 80s, space, 90s-game, or fine-art / art-movement (Kandinsky, Goya, Bauhaus, Cubism, Expressionism, Fauvism, folk art, Impressionism) look. Invoke /skill:adar-design <mode> to force a mode.

arcade.name: 80s Arcade
arcade.summary: 8-bit arcade cabinet: deep indigo ground, neon pink/cyan/yellow, hard 4px pixel borders, and Press Start 2P display type.

atari-sierra.name: Atari / Sierra Logo Treatment
atari-sierra.summary: Sliced 80s publisher logos: a wordmark or divider cut into horizontal bands that step thick-to-thin, filled with a red/orange/yellow/green/blue rainbow over a near-black or silver field.

effects.wordmarkSlice: clip-path: inset(0 0 calc(100% - var(--band-top)) 0) per band; each band of the letterform is a separate <span> with its own height and 1px plate offset

bauhaus.name: Bauhaus / Functional Geometry
bauhaus.summary: Bauhaus school interface: cream ground, primary red/blue/yellow with black rules, radius 0, strict 4px grid, and a circle/square/triangle vocabulary that always does a job.

effects.grid: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(20,20,20,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(20,20,20,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px)

bios.name: BIOS / POST / Text-mode
bios.summary: Award BIOS blue POST screen, VGA 16-color attributes, IBM 3270 mainframe fields, and DOS shell chrome — a hardware text-mode aesthetic.

c64.name: Commodore 64 / PETSCII
c64.summary: Commodore 64 home computer: a chunky 40x25 PETSCII screen of light-blue bitmap type on deep blue, wrapped in the bright blue border frame, with a locked 16-color hardware palette.

cubism.name: Cubism
cubism.summary: Analytic-cubist canvas: a warm cream ground broken into offset charcoal-edged planes of ochre, olive, warm gray, and blue-gray, one form drawn from several viewpoints at once, with flat papier collé cuts instead of shadows or gradients.

cyberpunk.name: Cyberpunk / Neon Noir
cyberpunk.summary: Neon-noir cyberpunk: a near-black #0a0a0f field under hot magenta and cyan glow, 1px HUD chrome with chamfered corners, glitch/RGB-split states, scanlines, film grain, and terminal fragments.

expressionism.name: Expressionism
expressionism.summary: Early-20th-century Expressionism as cloth: a near-black ground over deep blue, blood-red and acid-yellow emotional color, condensed display type, and wavy distorted brushstroke edges that make the whole surface feel strained.

fauvism.name: Fauvism / Wild Colour / Cut-Paper Planes
fauvism.summary: Early-modernist gallery surface: warm cream canvas, wild arbitrary red/orange/yellow/green/blue set down as flat opaque planes inside 3px ink contours, simplified silhouettes, and depth made from a second colour block instead of a shadow.

shadow.hard: none — elevation is an offset colour plane (transform: translate(10px, 10px) on a ::before block), never a box-shadow
shadow.plane: 0 10px 0 0 transparent (placeholder for the offset plane slot; draw the plane as a real element, not a shadow)

folk-art.name: Folk Art
folk-art.summary: Naive hand-painted folk art: warm cream ground, flat red/blue/green/yellow fills, ink brush strokes, decorative floral and geometric borders, and lettering that looks painted by a careful amateur.

gameboy.name: Game Boy LCD
gameboy.summary: Nintendo DMG handheld: a four-shade olive-green LCD, dot-matrix texture, chunky 4px pixels, hard edges, and Press Start 2P over VT323.

goya.name: Goya / Black Paintings
goya.summary: Goya's dark late period as an interface: near-black grounds, bone-white highlights, somber earth pigments, blood-red accents, and figures emerging from shadow under etched crosshatch.

effects.vignette: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 42%, transparent 0%, transparent 26%, rgba(13,11,9,.55) 62%, rgba(0,0,0,.94) 100%)

impressionism.name: Impressionism — Light & Color
impressionism.summary: Plein-air light study: cream canvas, five low-saturation pastels behaving like mixed pigment, broken brushstroke rules, dissolved edges, and a soft dappled-light overlay drifting across a strict underlying grid.

effects.dapple: radial-gradient(circle at 18% 22%, rgba(246,231,178,.55) 0 14px, transparent 15px), radial-gradient(circle at 46% 38%, rgba(246,231,178,.38) 0 22px, transparent 23px), radial-gradient(circle at 72% 14%, rgba(163,201,168,.22) 0 18px, transparent 19px), radial-gradient(circle at 88% 56%, rgba(246,231,178,.30) 0 12px, transparent 13px), radial-gradient(circle at 34% 76%, rgba(184,167,214,.20) 0 20px, transparent 21px)

kandinsky.name: Kandinsky / Synesthetic Abstraction
kandinsky.summary: Fine-art canvas UI after Kandinsky: warm cream ground, overlapping circles, quarter-arcs, and ruled line-segments in red/yellow/blue struck with 3px black outlines, arranged like a musical score and moving only in slow, contemplative drift.

nasa80.name: NASA 80s / Worm / Space
nasa80.summary: Deep-space interface: starfield black, a red worm wordmark, thin geometric type, and blueprint grid lines borrowed from mission documentation.

effects.starfield: radial-gradient(1px 1px at 12% 18%, #e6e8f0 50%, transparent 51%), radial-gradient(1px 1px at 68% 34%, #e6e8f0 50%, transparent 51%), radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 42% 72%, #e6e8f0 50%, transparent 51%), radial-gradient(1px 1px at 88% 61%, #7d89a6 50%, transparent 51%), radial-gradient(1px 1px at 26% 88%, #7d89a6 50%, transparent 51%), #050510
effects.blueprintGrid: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(42, 111, 151, 0.18) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(42, 111, 151, 0.18) 1px, transparent 1px)

stranger-things.name: Red-Neon Serif / 80s Synth-Horror
stranger-things.summary: 80s synth-horror title card: a high-contrast serif wordmark burning in red neon on near-black #050505, off-white mono copy, faint film grain and a heavy vignette.

effects.grain: repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 17% 32%, rgba(232, 226, 216, 0.035) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px), repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 71% 68%, rgba(255, 26, 26, 0.03) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px)

terminal.name: Terminal / CRT
terminal.summary: Phosphor-green CRT terminal: green monospace on near-black green-cast glass, scanlines, blinking block cursor, prompt-driven chrome.

tim.name: The Incredible Machine
tim.summary: 90s puzzle-game workbench: warm cream canvas, crayon red/yellow/blue/green parts, 3px ink outlines, chunky pills, and a visible chain of cause and effect that runs left to right.

vaporwave.name: Vaporwave / Synthwave
vaporwave.summary: Synthwave sunset: deep purple night ground, hot pink/cyan/yellow neon, a striped sunset sun over a cyan perspective grid, and a chrome-gradient wordmark.

effects.vignette: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 118%, rgba(255,140,66,0.35) 0%, transparent 52%), radial-gradient(ellipse at center, transparent 42%, rgba(11,6,32,0.78) 100%)

win95.name: Windows 95 Desktop
win95.summary: Windows 95 classic desktop GUI: teal #008080 field, silver #c0c0c0 chrome, navy #000080 title bars, black 11px system type, and the only beveled depth model in the system — 2px outset/inset, radius 0, no glow.

effects.pixelate: none — keep image-rendering: auto and scale icons by integer factors only (16/32/48px)

neon-console.name: Neon Console
neon-console.summary: Arcade neon geometry with terminal/CRT type, scanlines, and motion.
neon-console.signatureElement: Arcade pixel-border panels with a phosphor-green typewriter cursor.
